{{Quote|The New Republic is winning, even as we speak. You and your fellow resistance members are to be congratulated. Garos IV is free.|[[Jaalib Brandl]]|<ref name="BbK" />}}
The '''Battle of Garos''' occurred during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] shortly after the end of the [[Thrawn campaign]]. The planet [[Garos IV]] was freed by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] after years of intense local resistance against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Background==
{{Quote|There's work to be done on Garos.''"<br />"''You'll have some extra help now.|[[Alexandra Winger]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="RwD">{{JournalCite|6|Rendezvous with Destiny}}</ref>}}
Following the death of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], [[Alexandra Winger]], a member of the [[Committee of Seven for Garosian Unification|Garosian resistance]], was involved in a [[Mission to Sarahwiee|mission]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarahwiee]] with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and the [[Katarn Commandos|Page's Commandos]].<ref name="RwD" /> Alex Winger's actions brought [[Garos IV]]'s situation to the attention of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] which sent a fleet to Garos.<ref name="TEGtPaM" />

[[File:Jaalib2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Jaalib Brandl]] meets [[Tork Winger|Tork]] and [[Alexandra Winger]] shortly before the battle.]]

In preparation of the New Republic invasion, [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Jaalib Brandl]] was charged to oversee the evacuation of the Imperial dignitaries from the capital [[Ariana]].<ref name="BbK" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|The New Republic forces have arrived. They should be here in a few minutes.|Jaalib Brandl|<ref name="BbK" />}}
During the beginning battle, Alexandra Winger and [[Tork Winger|her adoptive father]], the Imperial [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of Garos IV were kidnapped by Brandl who decided to betray the Empire and kill the governor. Tork Winger was severely injured but Alex managed to convince the Dark Jedi to release them.<ref name="BbK" />

The New Republic fought the outnumbered Imperial forces on the planet,<ref name="TEGtPaM" /> with support of the Garosian resistance.<ref name="BbK" /> The battle was short and damage to the planet was light.<ref name="DT2">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]''</ref> [[Matt Turhaya]], Alex Winger's biological father was killed during the assault.<ref name="SoG" />

==Aftermath==
After the battle, Garos IV joined the New Republic.<ref name="DT2" /> A prisoner exchange took place a few weeks after the battle, allowing [[Dair Haslip]] to infiltrate the Imperial forces once again.<ref name="SoG" />

The popularity of the [[University of Garos]] caused an economic upswing of the planet during following years.<ref name="DT2" />
